Cornucopians, 

Over the past few weeks, there has been quite a bit of speculation on how our Discord roles will come into play for future NFT sales, particularly our upcoming land sale. While details of our land sale are yet to be announced, we want to take a moment to provide a little more detail and information on how we plan to implement roles in our future sales, starting with the land sale.

As previously mentioned, our recently launched custom marketplace allows us to verify users based on email and Discord roles. This helps us all in many ways. First, no matter what, we will always have users' contact information attached to each sale which will help us when any support issues arise. 

Second, for any sale, we are able to restrict access based on Discord roles. By doing this, we avoid a massive flood of "unknown" users, including bots, on our site. This will prevent major minting issues that have been seen in the past.

The other obvious perk is that by utilizing our Discord verification bot, we have the opportunity to reward our OGs and NFT holders, by allowing them access to sales prior to going fully public. 

What this "IS": Special access to our marketplace providing greater chance at minting
What this is "NOT": Whitelist guaranteeing mint

ROLE TIERS + SALE ACCESS

Our land sale will be structured in a way that will grant access by roles. Each role tier will be allotted a window of time to mint their NFT. Once the minting window has been completed for a particular role, the next tier will open. We will cycle through the following tiers in order until we are completely sold out. 

1. Old Guard Role (OGs) 
2. Javelin, Bubblejett, OG Bubblejett Holders (not OG Role)
3. Cornucopians T1 - 30 days or more in the server
4. Cornucopians T2 - 0-30 days

Obviously, the higher the tier you fall into, the greater your odds of minting. It is IMPORTANT to understand that: 
1. Having multiple roles falling into different tiers WILL NOT grant you additional mints
2. Owning more NFTs will not grant you additional mints
3. NFT rarity does not affect tier
4. If you sell your NFT, you will lose your discord role
5. We will restrict max mints based on Discord ID

NEXT STEP: VERIFY YOUR NFT ON DISCORD

We are still working out the final details of the land sale so please be patient and wait for our official announcement. Everyone needs to focus on getting verified as a holder NOW!

Cornucopians, 

Cornucopias community helps to bridge the Metaverse with the real world by planting real trees!

As you all know, leading up our land sale we have been hinting at a test sale involving NFT Trees. We call it "NFT2Tree". This is a VERY special NFT because we will be making real world impact by planting a Cornucopias Forest with our partners veritree! Our chosen location for planting the forest is Senegal, Africa! Continue reading for a few more details...

The Cornucopias NFT2Tree is a unique and environmentally conscious way to bridge the gap between the Metaverse and real life! Cornucopias is helping to lead the restorative economy by partnering with veritree, a restorative project that recently planted 1,001,000 trees with the help of the Cardano Foundation! The veritree project has a long history of planting trees across the globe in an effort to sequester CO2 from our atmosphere, and restore locations that have been devastated by deforestation. veritree uses a suite of tools to verify tree planting efforts, then publishes the planting data on chain. Minting trees on Cardano assures that the trees cannot be double counted. Once our Senegal trees have been planted, we will have our very own veritree webpage where we can monitor the growth and statistics of our forest! Lastly, every penny earned from secondary royalties will be allocated to planting additional trees in The Cornucopias Forest!

Key Takeaways: 
1). 100% of sale amount will go to Veritree
2). 100% of the 5% royalties will go to Veritree (spawning more IRL trees!)

Help us get there!! 

We will soon announce all the sale details along with instruction on how to create an account on our Cornucopias Marketplace.

Cornucopians, 

Yesterday was a huge success for the cornucopias team and community! As many of you know, we're nearing the launch of the highly anticipated land sale. Because land is such an important part of our game and essential to "get right," we are taking every step necessary to prepare. That of course includes making sure that our marketplace is ready to handle the huge demand expected and experienced in previous sales. Even though yesterday's test was a great success we plan to run another test to surface and address any unforeseen variables. 

Why Test? Why Trees?

Simulating real demand in these test sales is vital to extract the data and polish the processes needed to provide the best marketplace experience possible. The only way to do this is to test with a real NFT that has real value. This is why we, as a team, decided to create these test mints in a way that will benefit our planet and community. Our partnership with veritree is a perfect relationship that allows us to donate ALL proceeds from these test sales and secondary market sales toward planting trees in real life. And you, as a holder, will be able to plant your digital tree in our Cornucopias Metaverse and receive "special" airdrops in the game.

Wen Test #2

Our second test will be early next week, and the NFT will be a fruit tree on a different policy ID. The price will remain the same and so will the utility. PLEASE remember that these tests are for the greater good of our planet and the fruit trees provide food and commerce to struggling communities. By participating in these test sales, you are doing something great and also helping us to build the best marketplace on the entire Cardano blockchain.

Max Mint: 1 Per user

For our land sale, we have the user quota for an NFT set to 1. So, let's explore this in more detail. There are two scenarios to consider:

Example: 
1). If I’m in Tier 2 (NFT Holder) and I mint successfully, I can no longer attempt to mint for this round of minting. My user quota has been met. 
2). If I’m in Tier 2 (NFT Holder) and I’m unsuccessful, my user quota will not have been met, and I will still be able to attempt minting the next tier so long as I have the required role. 

So, if you have a holder role, Cornucopian T1, and Cornucopian roles, you will have the opportunity to try to mint 3 times, if the first two tiers are unsuccessful for you.
